title: Quaint Sweet British Tofu Noodles
description: A sweet and nostalgic British dish featuring marinated tofu and dashi extract, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together dashi extract, soy sauce, maple syrup, and rice vinegar to make the marinade.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Remove the tofu from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off, and add it to the skillet.
Cook the tofu until it is golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the tofu.
Season with salt, black pepper, and sesame seeds, and serve hot.
